name: ralph-wiggum-loop.sh
description: Autonomous iterative AI development MCP server (Bash edition for Linux/macOS) with spec-driven worker/reviewer SHIP/REVISE loops.

args: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { for d in /opt/homebrew/bin /usr/local/bin; do [ -d "$d" ] && [ "${PATH#*$d}" = "$PATH" ] && PATH="$d:$PATH"; done; export PATH; }; exec sh "$0" "$@"

tools.name: ralph_loop_initialize
tools.description: Initialize a new Ralph Loop session with a task specification and optional model/profile overrides.

tools.name: ralph_loop_get_task
tools.description: Retrieve the current task description and iteration context.

tools.name: ralph_loop_submit_work
tools.description: Submit worker iteration output, summary of changes, and files modified for reviewer evaluation.

tools.name: ralph_loop_get_work
tools.description: Retrieve the latest worker submission for review.

tools.name: ralph_loop_submit_review
tools.description: Submit reviewer evaluation with SHIP or REVISE decision, structured feedback, and issue list.

tools.name: ralph_loop_get_feedback
tools.description: Retrieve the latest reviewer decision, feedback, and issues.

tools.name: ralph_loop_get_status
tools.description: Inspect the current loop state, iteration counter, phase, and history.

tools.name: ralph_loop_get_config
tools.description: Retrieve the active session configuration, worker/reviewer models, and profile settings.

tools.name: ralph_loop_reset
tools.description: Cancel or reset the active Ralph Loop session.

tools.name: ralph_loop_block
tools.description: Mark the loop as blocked when human intervention or external clarification is required.

tools.name: ralph_loop_run
tools.description: Execute a full automated Worker/Reviewer Ralph Loop run for a task.
